acm.common.ansible.password_connect_host:
Note:
This Ansible configuration acts on a specific machine, which is different from group Ansible configurations and asset type Ansible configurations. This Ansible configuration has the highest priority.
Note:
The machine must fill in the Ansible execution node column (ie: INSTANCE_GROUP attribute) when importing
If you need to modify the node configuration, please go to the automatic configuration management->device storage Manage -> Manage user name and password and perform node configuration separately
Otherwise, the task will be sent to the default node for execution
The current user who can SSH to the target machine
The password of the current user who can SSH to connect to the target machine
The content of the id_rsa.pub file that needs to be sent
The default address of the file is ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
